baseline_observation: JSON-to-refinement and JSON-to-affine-subtraction pipelines panic for both malformed inputs.
candidate_observation: The negative-square-root affine-subtraction pipeline instead returns exact rational -1 with a singleton certified interval. The missing-payload pipelines still panic.
decision: Withhold the explicit affine subtraction candidate. Passing valid-input suites do not override the newly reproduced invalid-input failure masking.
independent_oracle: No real number has square -1; malformed serialized sqrt(-1) cannot be certified as a real-valued operand. An Irrational class without its required payload is structurally invalid.
required_acceptance: Malformed JSON and CBOR must be rejected as typed failures at their owning boundary before a scalar can enter a downstream pipeline. Preserve valid representation round trips, the complete existing corpus, and explicit uncertainty/resource contracts. Reproduce and validate the repaired boundary before revisiting affine admission.
